message:
Partial refunds now come out at the right amount. In `src/payments/partial-refund.js`, `percent` is documented as 0–100 but was being multiplied in directly, so the refund was 100 times too big. It's now divided by 100 before rounding.

`npm test` passes, all 20 tests, including `test/payments-partial-refund.test.js`.
